diagnostics.description: This property value named getDirectory is later overwritten by an object member with the same name.

message.content: This property value named getDirectory is later overwritten by an object member with the same name.

log.content: If an object property with the same name is defined multiple times (except when combining a getter with a setter), only the last definition makes it into the object and previous definitions are ignored.
Unsafe fix: Remove this property value named getDirectory
